verdicts.reason: Both pull all text out of the label frame, leaving a large empty white cartouche, and shrink the lavender illustration into a tiny strip floating in a huge dead lower half. A is worse. It leaves orphaned divider rules stranded inside the empty frame, crams 'J'adore Paris / LAVANDER / SKINCARE' into one cramped row with tiny SKINCARE text, and sets HOMEMADE LOTION small and off-axis. B at least keeps the dividers with their text and gives LAVANDER and HOMEMADE LOTION more presence. Still, the brand lockup is jammed against the top edge and the frame is a meaningless blank box.
